No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this day you study a fortified historic town and its architectural layers.

Transport from Delhi, the start time, meals and pace are arranged with you, and the quotation states exactly what is included.

What it covers

  • Arrive and landscape orientation
  • Accessible fort viewpoints
  • Town heritage context
  • Debrief

How the time is spent

  1. Arrive and landscape orientation 30 min

    Place Hansi in Haryana defensive networks.

    You: map chronology

  2. Accessible fort viewpoints 45 min

    Compare earthwork, walls and later fabric.

    You: fort sketch

  3. Town heritage context 45 min

    Examine relationships to urban settlement.

    You: street observations

  4. Debrief 30 min

    Differentiate local traditions from documented phases.

    You: evidence chart

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Situate Hansi within its regional historical context.
  • Use observable topography and published evidence to test an interpretation.
  • Produce a concise field record with uncertainty clearly identified.

You take away

A field sheet comparing what you saw.

Language
English, Hindi or both. Other languages on request, through our partners.
Group size
Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Starting point
Delhi, or wherever you are staying in the region.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water, a hat and sun protection. Much of the day is outdoors.
